flags.why: "coverage lettering" 不是英语中存在的搭配（母语者只会说 map legend/lettering），glossary 里该词条的 m（覆盖说明）和例句（The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.）同样不通，属生造硬凑。
flags.fixEn: Beneath the small [[coverage lettering:lettering]] on his map, there was even a short reading [[bibliography:bibliography]].
flags.fixZh: 他地图上那行小小的标注文字下面，甚至还附了一份简短的阅读书目。

flags.why: "an approximately clear study diagram" 中 approximately 只修饰可量度的数量概念，母语者不会用 approximate 修饰 clear 这类形容词，属生硬塞词的非地道搭配。
flags.fixEn: Late at [[night:night]], Sam drew an [[approximately:approximately]] correct study [[diagram:diagram]] on the whiteboard.
flags.fixZh: 深夜里，山姆在白板上画了一张大体正确的学习图表。

flags.why: 人物代词自相矛盾：15.1 "Lin explained her simple study ratio"、22.1 "Lin put forward... for her friends to test" 均用 her 指林，本句却写 "Lin packed his backpack"，同一角色性别指代断裂。
flags.fixEn: Every morning, Lin packed her [[backpack:backpack]] with lunch and one red book.

flags.why: 句子以标记词开头但 display 为小写 "senior"，整句以小写字母开头，违反英文句首大写的硬性规则（对比 9.0 Opening、46.0 Vigorous 等句首标记均已大写）。
flags.fixEn: [[senior:Senior]] students showed a short [[thesis:thesis]] and a neat model [[paper:paper]] as guides.
